upstream.description: An autonomous agent for deep financial research

classification.analysis: Dexter is an autonomous financial research agent built in TypeScript/Bun that decomposes complex financial questions into research plans, autonomously calls tools to pull real-time market data (income statements, balance sheets, cash flow), self-checks its work, and iterates until confident. It ships as an interactive terminal UI (like Claude Code but for finance), includes an eval suite with LangSmith tracking and LLM-as-judge scoring, a scratchpad debug log, and a WhatsApp gateway so users can chat with the agent via their own WhatsApp number. It is explicitly for educational/informational use, not real trading advice, and targets developers or hobbyists exploring agentic financial research.

use_cases.title: Ask an autonomous agent to research a stock using live financial statements
Chat with a financial research agent through your own WhatsApp number
Evaluate agent accuracy on financial Q&A with LLM-as-judge scoring
Study a real-world TUI agent architecture for task planning and tool execution
